Messages.Author: Ivan Lerth
Messages.Body:
Hello ,

What happens if in the same combat round I use a celerity card that gives me
additional strikes, when I'm also using a Potence strike card that gives +X
hand damage... does every strike have the +X modifier or only the first
strike? (and having to use additional potence cards for the rest of the
strikes)...

... other question, can multiple celerity cards (with additional strikes) be
played in the same turn?

Thanks for answering,

Messages.Author: Vince Johnson
Messages.Body:
Ivan Lerth <ile...@my-dejanews.com> wrote in message
news:7h283i$2st$1...@nnrp1.deja.com...

> Hello ,
>
> What happens if in the same combat round I use a celerity card that gives
me
> additional strikes, when I'm also using a Potence strike card that gives
+X
> hand damage... does every strike have the +X modifier or only the first
> strike? (and having to use additional potence cards for the rest of the
> strikes)...
>

Something that says Strike: +x hand damage, only lasts for that single
strike (such as undead Strength. Bonus's to strength from something like a
Torn sigpost last all combat or however listed based on the card.

> ... other question, can multiple celerity cards (with additional strikes)
be
> played in the same turn?

Nope, Latest Rules state that you can only gain additional strikes from a
single source.

Vince

Messages.Author: DOUGDWISE
Messages.Body:
>... other question, can multiple celerity cards (with additional strikes) be
>played in the same turn?
>
>

Only one card giving additional strikes can be played in a round of combat.
That's out of the rules. But I seem to recall that one of the Sabbat celerity
cards could be played ignoring the rule, adding to additional strikes from
another card.

Keeper of the curse and Master of the Knife.
Clear all chaff to write to me.
